harness/packages/quds_office_editor/pubs.text:
name: quds_office_editor
publish_to: none
description: >-
  Flutter Office surfaces on custom RenderBox: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF
  viewer/editor, and a visual band-report designer with inspector and preview.
version: 1.6.0
homepage: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite
repository: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/tree/main/packages/quds_office_editor
issue_tracker: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/issues

topics:
  - flutter
  - office
  - editor
  - pdf
  - word

platforms:
  android:
  ios:
  linux:
  macos:
  web:
  windows:

screenshots:
  - description: "Report designer: bands, rulers, chart element, and the professional inspector."
    path: example/screenshots/report_designer.png
  - description: "Report designer live preview: paginated output painted from the engine."
    path: example/screenshots/report_preview.png
  - description: "Arabic RTL invoice template in the report designer."
    path: example/screenshots/report_designer_rtl.png
  - description: "Ready-made product catalog template with its photos saved inside the .qrep."
    path: example/screenshots/report_template_catalog.png
  - description: "Data explorer: edit the report's tables, typed columns, and calculated columns."
    path: example/screenshots/report_data_explorer.png
  - description: "Shape map in the designer: import a shapefile or GeoJSON and bind it to the value table."
    path: example/screenshots/report_shape_map.png
  - description: "Word canvas: paginated pages, BiDi caret, outline, and custom chrome."
    path: example/screenshots/word.png
  - description: "Excel grid: virtualized sheet, formula bar, charts, and sheet tabs."
    path: example/screenshots/excel.png
  - description: "PowerPoint stage: slides, animations pane, and slide sorter."
    path: example/screenshots/powerpoint.png
  - description: "PDF viewer: fit page, thumbnails, and view options."
    path: example/screenshots/pdf.png

environment:
  sdk: ^3.12.0
  flutter: ">=3.44.0"

dependencies:
  url_launcher: ^6.3.1
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  quds_office_engine:
    path: ../quds_office_engine
  quds_reports:
    path: ../quds_reports

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter

flutter:
  uses-material-design: false
  assets:
    - fonts/
    - templates/

harness/packages/quds_office_engine/pubs.text:
name: quds_office_engine
publish_to: none
description: >-
  Pure Dart Office, PDF, and report engine: DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, formulas, BiDi/RTL,
  PdfFile, pdf_widgets, and .qrep band reports exported to PDF, XLSX, and DOCX.
version: 1.5.0
homepage: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite
repository: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/tree/main/packages/quds_office_engine
issue_tracker: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/issues

topics:
  - office
  - docx
  - xlsx
  - pptx
  - pdf

screenshots:
  - description: "Quds Report Studio: a desktop .qrep designer built on this engine (Windows and Linux installers)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_studio_designer.png
  - description: "A DOCX saved by LibreOffice Writer: its own PDF next to this engine's pure-Dart OfficePdfExport."
    path: example/screenshots/office_fidelity_word.png
  - description: "Band report: sales dashboard with KPI cards, vector charts, and grouped tables (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_performance.png
  - description: "Band report: Arabic RTL VAT invoice with QR code and amount in words (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_invoice_ar.png
  - description: "Band report: Arabic account statement with running balance and area chart (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_account_statement_ar.png
  - description: "Ready-made template: product catalog with photos saved inside the .qrep, open in Quds Report Studio."
    path: example/screenshots/report_studio_templates.png
  - description: "Ready-made template: Arabic certificate of appreciation with embedded seal and signature (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_certificate_ar.png
  - description: "The same report exported to XLSX with native Excel charts and typed cells."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_performance_xlsx.png
  - description: "Chart gallery: pie, waterfall, funnel, gauge, bullet, scatter, and bubble, drawn as vectors."
    path: example/screenshots/report_chart_gallery.png
  - description: "Shape map: countries colored from a table, with a legend and labels on wide regions."
    path: example/screenshots/report_shape_map.png

platforms:
  android:
  ios:
  linux:
  macos:
  web:
  windows:

environment:
  sdk: ^3.12.0

dependencies:
  legacy_doc_parser:
    path: ../legacy_doc_parser
  characters: ^1.4.1
  crypto: ^3.0.7

dev_dependencies:
  lints: ^6.0.0
  test: ^1.26.0

harness/packages/quds_reports/pubspec.ya.text:

homepage: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite
repository: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/tree/main/packages/quds_reports
issue_tracker: https://github.com/MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite/issues

topics:
  - reports
  - pdf
  - invoice
  - excel
  - word

screenshots:
  - description: "Band report: sales dashboard with KPI cards, vector charts, and a grouped table (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_performance.png
  - description: "Arabic RTL VAT invoice with a QR code and the amount in words (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_invoice_ar.png
  - description: "Arabic account statement with a running balance and an area chart (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_account_statement_ar.png
  - description: "Arabic certificate of appreciation with an embedded seal and signature (PDF)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_certificate_ar.png
  - description: "Chart gallery: columns, lines, pies, gauges, and extruded charts drawn as vectors."
    path: example/screenshots/report_chart_gallery.png
  - description: "Shape map: countries colored from a table, with a legend and labels."
    path: example/screenshots/report_shape_map.png
  - description: "The same sales report exported to XLSX with native Excel charts."
    path: example/screenshots/report_sales_performance_xlsx.png
  - description: "Quds Report Studio: the desktop designer for .qrep files (Windows and Linux)."
    path: example/screenshots/report_studio_designer.png
  - description: "Live preview in the studio: paginated pages painted from the engine."
    path: example/screenshots/studio_preview.png
  - description: "Ready-made product catalog open in the studio, photos saved inside the .qrep."
    path: example/screenshots/report_studio_templates.png

platforms:

  ios:
  linux:
  macos:
  web:
  windows:
